install_dir.description: Base directory where testssl.sh is installed.

openssl_path.description: Path to the OpenSSL binary used for SSL/TLS checks.

openssl_2_path.description: Optional second OpenSSL binary for TLS 1.3 support if the primary one lacks it.

output_dir.description: Directory where output files (log, json, csv, html) will be stored. If empty, uses current working directory.

wide_output.description: Enable wide output mode to display full cipher suite names.

color_output.description: Color output mode: 0=no color, 1=markup, 2=ansi color, 3=color rated.

nodns.description: DNS lookup behavior: 'min' (A/AAAA only) or 'none' (no DNS lookups).

connect_timeout.description: Connect timeout for TCP sockets in seconds.

phone_out.description: Enable checks for revoked certificates via OCSP/CRL. Must be 'true' or 'false'.

additional_ca_files.description: Comma-separated list of CA files or directories for trust chain validation.

assume_http.description: Force HTTP detection to enable HTTP header checks and client simulation.

basicauth.description: HTTP Basic Auth credentials in 'user:pass' format for header checks.

reqheaders.description: List of additional HTTP request headers in 'HeaderName: HeaderValue' format.

user_agent.description: User-Agent string for HTTP header checks.

days2warn1.description: First certificate expiration warning threshold in days.

days2warn2.description: Second certificate expiration warning threshold in days.

hsts_min.description: HSTS minimum validity period in days for warning.

hpkp_min.description: HPKP minimum validity period in days for warning.

severity_threshold.description: Severity threshold for file output (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL).

overwrite.description: Overwrite existing output files without prompting.

max_parallel.description: Maximum number of parallel tests in mass testing mode.

max_wait_test.description: Maximum wait time for a single test in parallel mass testing in seconds.

ssl_native.description: Use native OpenSSL checks only (faster, less accurate).

ign_ocsp_proxy.description: Ignore OCSP proxy restrictions and check OCSP directly.

ca_bundles_path.description: Path to custom CA bundles directory, overriding builtin paths.

max_socket_fail.description: Maximum socket failures before giving up.

max_ossl_fail.description: Maximum OpenSSL failures before giving up.

max_header_fail.description: Maximum HTTP header failures before giving up.

all_clients.description: Run all clients (126+) in client simulation.

show_each.description: Show each cipher tested in wide modes.

mapping.description: Cipher suite name mapping: openssl, iana, no-openssl, no-iana.

colorblind.description: Enable colorblind mode (swaps green and blue).

ids_friendly.description: IDS-friendly mode (skips Heartbleed, CCS, Ticketbleed, ROBOT).

sneaky.description: Use sneaky Firefox-like user agent for HTTP header checks.
